query: mongodb-rate. All seven recorded changes to mongodb-rate cluster into a ~20-second span roughly one minute before onset (15:00:51-15:01:10 on 2026-10-03), and all are attributed to the platform-automation actor rather than a human operator. The change set describes first-time creation of the workload rather than modification of a running one: the container is logged as first created, alongside creation of the Service, two ConfigMaps, and a PersistentVolumeClaim. The PersistentVolumeClaim named rate-pvc was created and then updated twice within about seven seconds, making storage configuration the only element that was changed after initial creation. One of the created ConfigMaps carries a name indicating fault-injection or failure-administration intent for this service, which is a strong candidate for the proximate cause given it landed seconds before the workload container came up.
